description: Na₃CaAl₃Si₃SO₁₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and three longer (2.59 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.75 Å) and one longer (1.77 Å) Al-O bond length. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.47 Å) and three longer (1.51 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Ca and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom.
